notes.title: Development Update - August 2022
notes.notes:
Greetings, Medics!

We are sorry for the lack of posts recently. At the same time, we want to assure you that we are working hard on Medic: Pacific War and that the development is steadily going forward. Recently we were looking for our available options on making Medic: Pacific War better, and even though we have achieved great success recently, the details regarding the whole situation have to be kept a secret for a little while longer. 

Release date

Let's get back to the most important things. A lot of you are probably wondering how much longer you have to wait in order to play the final Medic: Pacific War game. Our current aim is to launch the game in the first half of 2023. We know that the wait is long for many of you, but our main priority is to make the game as good, as we can. We are thankful for your patience and we hope that you can give us some more time to finish the development. 

What are we working on?
If you have to wait so long, what can you expect in return? 

 Medic: Pacific War is coming to next-gen consoles (final list to be announced), 
 We are implementing new wound types to provide a more varied gaming experience,  
 The dialogues are being currently rewritten by a professional writer, 
 Full professional voice-acting is planned after rewriting the dialogues, 
 We are adding collectibles to the game, 
 Polishing the gameplay, cutscenes, fixing the bugs. 

All of it and probably even more is waiting for you at the launch of Medic: Pacific War. Thank you for ongoing support. All your messages, e-mails, and posts, on both Steam and our Discord, matter a lot to us. Without your help, this game would never happen. We are extremely grateful! 

Best regards,
Hypnotic Ants Team

P.S. Check our Discord for more news and internal materials :)
